title: Tucheng Two-Year-Old Boy Death Case - "The child who died holding two bottles of milk"
court: Taiwan High Court｜Second Instance Preparatory Procedure
summary: Court observation notes of the second-instance preparation process on August 6: Both defendants admitted the criminal facts found in the first-instance, and the appeal focused on sentencing; the court also discussed matters such as sentencing appraisal, new evidence, and custody.
